# Coggle

> > Coggle is a collaborative mind-mapping and flowchart creation tool designed for teams, businesses, and individuals to visualize ideas and organize information.

Coggle offers a freemium platform for creating beautiful mind maps and flowcharts with real-time collaboration, markdown formatting, and enterprise features like SAML SSO. The platform serves users ranging from students and professionals to organizations seeking business-grade diagramming tools.
